names.title: Name generator
names.body: Batches of 10 explained names, with acronyms for associations, a score and domain (.com, .org, .gn, .africa…) and social handle checks.

logos.title: Logo generator and editor
logos.body: 8 vector proposals per batch shown in context, then an editor to adjust font, colours, icon and layout. SVG, PNG, PDF export and app icon pack.

signatures.title: Signatures
signatures.body: Tagline or motto, email signature compatible with Gmail and Outlook, stylised initials and an association stamp ready for a rubber stamp.

kit.title: Brand kit
kit.body: A shareable page, an automatically generated PDF brand guide and a tidy ZIP archive.

faq.q1: Can I pay with Orange Money?
faq.a1: Yes, Orange Money is our primary payment method. You confirm the payment on your phone.
faq.a3: On purchase, commercial usage rights are assigned to you and the logo becomes exclusive. We recommend registering the trademark with OAPI.
faq.q4: How do I get association pricing?
faq.a4: Upload your registration proof from the Billing page; an administrator validates it.
